thread:
ryan: Quick follow-up from the auth/provider outage. Need clear owners, dates, and a short plan for recurring-detection. Root cause: regional auth instability caused model-registry timeouts and missed fallbacks.

ryan: Proposed tasks:
1) Multi-region auth fallback + client short-circuit (owner: elena) - target 2026-04-12
2) Registry read fallback: local cache + blobstore fallback + backoff tuning (owner: samir) - target 2026-04-05
3) Recurring-incident detector + trend dashboard (owner: katie) - target 2026-04-20
4) Runbook: explicit circuit-break and degrade-to-local-model checklist (owner: jordan) - target 2026-03-30

elena: I'll take #1. Will add region failover and client short-circuit after 4 consecutive 5xxs. PR today.

samir: Taking #2. Plan: 5m TTL cache, stale_while_revalidate=30m, blobstore fallback for older manifests. Need infra for namespace mirroring.

katie: I'll own #3. Rule idea: alert when auth_error_rate > 5% over 3m AND registry_5xx_rate > 2% correlated. Start non-pager.

jordan: On runbook: add vendor-status check, flip to cached manifests, enable circuit breaker, route to alt region. Also add a CI smoke test to simulate auth 500s + registry 503s.

ryan: Created JIRAs RW-ENG-1245..1248. Ops-bot, attach incident logs and link these tickets.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0472 created and logs uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0472.zip. Linked to RW-ENG-1245..1248.

elena: Confirmed. PR soon.

samir: Confirmed, scheduling infra sync.

katie: Confirmed, RFC in my backlog.

jordan: Confirmed, updating runbook.

ryan: I'll run weekly follow-ups until everything is green. Post updates here. :thumbsup:
